messages:
elaine: Kicking off preflight for MIG-498 (index swap + backfill) in the 02:00-04:00 UTC change window tonight. Plan: 1) CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY new_idx ON events (user_id, created_at); 2) run distributed backfill workers with throttling; 3) short txn to swap pointers (UPDATE metadata SET idx = 'new' WHERE name='events_idx'); Canary rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~20m. Pin service image to api:v2.3.1 for the window. Please ack and call out concerns or additional rollback criteria.

deploy-bot: Deploy request MIG-498 created by elaine. Canary target: service/api pinned to api:v2.3.1. Canary group started. (CI artifacts: build-2026-03-23-498).

jay: ack. I'll tail lockwatch and pg_stat_activity. running local watcher: ./scripts/lockwatch.sh MIG-498 and prometheus alert dashboard open. Will report every 5m or on anomalies.

samira: ack. Two notes: (1) Backfill throttle: set global rate to 300 rows/s to avoid vacuum storms. (2) If autovacuum pause > 60s or any lock wait > 15s for index-related queries, escalate. Also prefer smaller concurrency per shard (concurrency=4).

dave: Adding explicit rollback criteria here so ops has clarity: - p95 API latency increases by >30% sustained across 3 consecutive 2-minute windows -> abort. - any single table lock held >30s on primary affecting writes -> abort. - replication lag > 2 minutes for >1 minute -> abort. Rollback action: /deploybot abort MIG-498-canary then revert pin: service/api -> previous stable (api:v2.3.0) and pause backfill. I'll own the rollback once aborted.

opsbot: Pinned service image on canary nodes to api:v2.3.1 (tag: mig-498-pin). Created alert bindings for the rollback criteria and added runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/mig-498-rollout

elaine: Thanks. Quick escape hatches for the team: 1) If we need immediate write-freeze, flip FF feature.index_swap_readonly = true (console link in runbook). 2) Abort canary: /deploybot abort MIG-498-canary (this re-routes traffic back and triggers rollback steps). Documented in release notes draft.

samira: One more technical note — backfill job uses idempotent upserts and checkpoints every 1m so it can resume safely after abort. SQL snippet for the pointer swap (do inside short txn):

```sql
BEGIN;
UPDATE metadata SET active_idx = 'new_idx' WHERE table_name = 'events';
-- quick check rows_count match
COMMIT;
```

This keeps the downtime minimal.

jay: starting first 5% canary traffic now. I'll post status at +5m, +10m etc. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary reached 5% at 1767809223. No errors reported from health checks in the first 3 minutes.

dave: I'm on pager standby; ping @dave if we hit rollback criteria and I'll lead the revert.

elaine: great. I'll update release notes with pinned version, change window, and the rollback steps (will paste final notes here once done). Thanks everyone for quick ack.
